description: Moving the Priest away from the binary "Light or Shadow" forms into a dual-wielding manipulator of lifeforce, treating health pools as communicable vessels. The goal is to shift the Priest from a standard reactive healer or pure shadow DPS into a logistical hub of distributed damage and healing.

items.name: Cord of Duality
items.stats:
+130 Intellect
+100 Spirit
Equip: Replaces Mind Flay with Twilight Tether, allowing you to link an ally and an enemy. Damage to the enemy heals the ally, and healing the ally damages the enemy.
items.description: The threads weave light and shadow into a single, unbroken cord.

setBonuses.text: (3) Set: Sever the Scales refunds 50% of its mana cost if it successfully executes an enemy.

origin.details: Drops from a cultist boss in a mid-tier dungeon.

catalyst.details: Re-spin the unraveling threads using pure light and shadow essences, and attach a stabilizing onyx-and-pearl clasp.

items.name: Mitre of the Weeping Judge
items.stats:
+140 Intellect
+110 Stamina
Equip: Allows you to maintain up to three separate Twilight Tethers simultaneously.
items.description: The tears of the judge fall for both the living and the dead.

setBonuses.text: (3) Set: Sever the Scales refunds 50% of its mana cost if it successfully executes an enemy.

items.baseItemName: Tarnished Mitre of the Weeping Judge

origin.details: An elite inquisitor drop in the open world.

catalyst.details: Polish and reforge the corrupted silver lattice, using a purifying solvent to restore the artifact's neutrality.

items.name: Gavel of the Final Verdict
items.stats:
+190 Intellect
+140 Mastery
Equip: Unlocks Sever the Scales. Snaps all active tethers instantly to execute the enemy or burst heal the ally based on health deficits.

setBonuses.text: (3) Set: Sever the Scales refunds 50% of its mana cost if it successfully executes an enemy.

items.baseItemName: Unbalanced Gavel of the Final Verdict

origin.details: Raid boss drop from a corrupted angelic or void entity.

catalyst.details: Install a weighted gyroscopic core to perfectly balance the weapon, and imbue it with the magic required to sever the tethers.
